title: An L-shaped outline drawn as one polygon with a square opening drawn as four loose lines
how: the four loose lines (3,3), (8,3), (8,8), (3,8) join end to end and close = a ring of 4 points and 25 mm2;
the polygon is the larger ring and every corner of the square lies inside the L (x from 3 to 8 is below 15, y from 3 to 8 is above 0), so 1 opening and nothing dropped.
